jobs.description:
Scope and Impact
You are an autonomous contributor holding end-to-end stewardship accountability for an assigned scope, on behalf of the business owners of that data. You balance stewardship responsibilities, analytics delivery, and self-service enablement while maximizing business value from data through trusted metrics, high-quality data products, and adoption of analytical solutions.
You may sit within a regional IT organization or directly within the business domain, depending on structure.
As a domain resource, you receive governance standards, tooling, and escalation support from the central Data & AI Governance function, Global Data & AI Platform team and the visualization engineering CoE.

What you do
Metrics & Data Products
Align existing and new metric definitions across teams so everyone works from the same numbers.
Curate metric definitions, metadata, and the semantic layer so they're reliable enough for AI agents to answer business questions directly, not just for human dashboard users.
Act as Data Steward for all data products within your assigned sub-domain.
Monitor and improve data quality through controls and remediation activities, elevating data quality and data management from source to the analytical layer.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, business glossaries, and ownership information within the enterprise data catalog.
Track and demonstrate the business value and ROI realized from the data products you steward, using this evidence to prioritize improvements or retirement.
Partner with Data Engineers to define the semantic layer in the global data and AI platform and understand how they built data models and pipelines.
Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.

Analytical Solutions
Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions.
Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers.
Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions.
Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.

Data Literacy 
Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain.
Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions

AI-readiness & Ways of Working 
Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle.

Where you will be
This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 
Benefits highlights
Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 

 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

jobs.occupation: R&D Scientist  Analytics & IoT for Power Systems
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
Innovation is at the core of Hitachi Energy, and our research centers are the backbone of our technology development. For our research center in Västerås, Sweden, we are looking for an R&D Scientist with expertise in data‑driven monitoring, diagnostics, and IoT solutions for power systems.
In this role, you will work in highly skilled, collaborative teams with access to state‑of‑the‑art laboratory and experimental facilities, contributing to technologies that enable a more sustainable and resilient energy system.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Identify technical requirements and drive innovation for future sustainable energy systems
Develop and deliver solutions to complex technical challenges within R&D projects
Validate new concepts through laboratory and field testing, including measurements, signal processing, and data analysis, and optimize solutions to meet technical and performance requirements
Manage R&D projects or work packages with a structured approach, clear targets, and effective technical leadership
Create ideas and proposals for R&D projects aligned with business needs and future commercial potential
Collaborate and communicate actively with team members, customers, suppliers, and partners in industry and academia
Deliver results in the form of software, hardware, technical reports, patent applications, scientific publications, and presentations
Build a strong internal network and actively share knowledge and expertise across the organization

Your Background
Preferably PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
Proven research experience related to digital substation equipment and architecture
Multidisciplinary knowledge in related areas such as IoT, communication and network architecture, and software development
Hands‑on programming experience, ideally across multiple programming languages
Knowledge and hands‑on experience in both classical and data‑driven signal processing and analysis techniques; experience in algorithm development is an advantage
Previous experience in leading R&D projects or work packages is an advantage
A curious mindset with the ability to adapt quickly to new technical challenges
Excellent communication skills and a strong team‑player attitude
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

What We Offer
Collective agreement
Flexible working hours
Health care and wellness allowance
Excellent career opportunities within Hitachi Energy, both in Sweden and globally
Dedicated mentorship support during the onboarding phase
Continuous training and professional development opportunities
A diverse and inclusive workplace, with over 70 nationalities represented in Sweden
Supplementary compensation during parental leave
Access to an employee benefit portal with a wide range of discounts and perks

More About Us
Are you ready for a new and exciting challenge? Does this role sound like you? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
For questions about the position, please contact the Recruiting Manager, Md Tanbhir Hoq (md-tanbhir.hoq1@hitachienergy.com).
Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Jonas Hedberg    +46 (10) 7380775, Unionen: Ingrid Nilsson    +46 21 32 14 66, Frank Hollstedt    +46 10 7387043. All other questions can be directed to our Talent Acquisition Partner Filip Henriksson (filip.henriksson@hitachienergy.com).
Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, enabling a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digitalization at the core. More than three billion people rely on our technologies every day. With over a century of pioneering expertise in high voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing one of the world’s most critical challenges—meeting growing electricity demand while decarbonizing the power system. Headquartered in Switzerland, Hitachi Energy employs over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generates revenues of approximately USD 16 billion.

The opportunity  
We are expanding and looking for a Senior Project Engineer to join our growing global team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of climate systems within HVDC projects, ensuring the reliable operation of HVDC stations around the world, from deserts to arctic regions, both onshore and offshore. 
 
“At Hitachi Energy, the Climate System team plays a key role in ensuring the reliability and performance of HVDC stations across the globe. We are building a strong, multidisciplinary organization that combines deep technical competence with collaboration and innovation. As a Senior Project Engineer, you’ll be part of this journey. If you are motivated by engineering excellence and global impact, we would be happy to welcome you to our team” - Farshad Abbasi, Manager Climate System 
 This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 

How you’ll make an impact 
Perform the technical design and calculations of climate systems for HVDC converter stations, including reviewing designs, drawings, documentation, and technical specifications. 
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure effective integration of climate systems within overall HVDC plant designs. 
Support all project phases—from tendering and conceptual design to detailed engineering, procurement, installation, and commissioning—ensuring quality and timely execution. 
Conduct design reviews to ensure compliance with customer requirements, ASHRAE standards, and internal guidelines. 
Assist with testing, verification, and performance validation during commissioning, including site inspections and on-site support. 
Translate customer needs into reliable and compliant climate system solutions. 
Contribute to continuous improvement efforts and mentor junior engineers to support technical development within the team. 

Your background 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Energy Systems, or a related field with a focus on heat transfer and fluid mechanics. 
Proven expertise in climate systems or HVAC equipment such as chillers, dehumidifiers, air handling units, and integrated monitoring and control sensors. 
Solid understanding of psychrometric charts, heat transfer (active/passive), flow diagrams, and control systems. 
Experience working on large-scale engineering projects is an advantage. 
You should ideally like working in a multicultural environment and be able to express yourself written and spoken in English. Swedish is considered an advantage. 

 
More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​  
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

 
The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

What you’ll do:

jobs.occupation: IT Procurement Consultant / Software Asset Manager
jobs.description:
IT Procurement Consultant / Software Asset Manager – Stockholm or Gothenburg🚀 About the Role
We are looking for an experienced IT Procurement Consultant or Software Asset Manager for an exciting consulting assignment focused on strategic IT sourcing, supplier management, and digital transformation.
In this role, you will play a key part in a major digital transformation programme, supporting strategic sourcing and procurement activities across IT and Operational Technology (OT).
You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT, architecture, information security, legal, and procurement teams to ensure effective sourcing strategies, well-informed supplier decisions, and sustainable commercial solutions.
This opportunity is ideal for someone with extensive experience in IT procurement or Software Asset Management who combines strong commercial awareness with analytical thinking and a results-oriented approach.
💼 Key Responsibilities
Conduct IT/OT category assessments and supplier market analyses to identify relevant services, capabilities, and potential suppliers.

Translate business, technical, architectural, security, and transition requirements into sourcing strategies and procurement plans.

Prepare, coordinate, and manage RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes.

Plan and monitor procurement milestones, dependencies, and key decisions.

Develop supplier evaluation criteria, commercial models, and scoring frameworks.

Coordinate supplier evaluations, shortlisting, clarification meetings, and negotiations.

Support contract negotiations, supplier onboarding, mobilisation, and handover activities.

Monitor supplier selection progress, timelines, commercial assumptions, risks, and decisions.

Provide procurement-related insights and recommendations for budget discussions, reporting, and steering committee decisions.

Ensure procurement activities align with governance, compliance, and programme objectives.

✅ Requirements
We are looking for someone who meets the following criteria:

At least 5 years of experience as a Procurement Consultant with a strong focus on software sourcing within IT, or at least 5 years of experience as a Software Asset Manager in large corporations.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to align commercial, technical, and business perspectives.

Strong analytical and organisational skills, with experience managing complex procurement activities and decision-making processes.

Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively, and maintain progress in dynamic environments.

Experience ensuring procurement quality, governance, compliance, and transparency.

Strong stakeholder management skills and experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

High integrity and sound judgement when handling commercially sensitive and confidential information.

A relevant university or college degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, IT, or equivalent professional experience.

🌟 Personal Qualities
To succeed in this role, you are commercially minded, analytical, structured, and proactive.
You are confident communicating with both technical specialists and senior decision-makers, and you have the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, and drive procurement activities forward.
You thrive in complex organisations, enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders, and can balance strategic priorities with operational delivery.
📍 Assignment Details
Location: Solna (Stockholm) or Gothenburg, Sweden

Start date: 9 November 2026

End date: 30 April 2027

Please note that your CV must be submitted in English.

Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.
Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and has grown to over 250 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.
Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
About the role
As a Credit Analyst at Northmill, you will play a key role in finding the right balance between sustainable business growth and responsible risk management. You will work across the entire credit lifecycle, from new customer acquisition and loan origination to portfolio monitoring and collections.
Through data-driven analysis, you will identify opportunities to improve our credit policies, optimise portfolio performance and ensure that our lending strategies remain aligned with Northmill's risk appetite.
This is a hands-on and analytical role where your insights and recommendations will have a direct impact on business decisions. You will work closely with colleagues across Credit Risk, Data Science, Data Engineering, Product and Marketing, translating complex analyses into actionable recommendations.
You will report to the Head of Credit Risk for B2C.
Key responsibilities

Analyse credit performance and identify opportunities to improve Northmill's credit policies and lending strategies.

Continuously monitor lending portfolios throughout the credit lifecycle, identifying trends, deviations and potential risks.

Develop data-driven recommendations and present proposals to the Credit Committee.

Follow up on implemented changes and evaluate their impact on portfolio performance and profitability.

Collaborate with Data Scientists on the development and ongoing improvement of credit models.

Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure data infrastructure and management support effective credit analysis.

Partner with Product and Marketing to balance lending growth, revenue generation and credit risk.

Represent the Credit function in cross-functional projects and drive the implementation of approved initiatives.

Who we are looking for
We are looking for someone with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity for understanding data and business performance, and the ability to turn insights into meaningful actions.
You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your analyses and making recommendations even when information is not always complete. You also enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders and can communicate complex analytical findings in a clear and accessible way.
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.

Experience as a Credit Analyst, Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.

Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.

Experience working with SQL and Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.

Advanced Excel skills.

Experience using AI tools such as Claude and/or Cursor in your day-to-day analytical work.

Fluency in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

What we offer

A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views

An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact

Great opportunities for professional development

Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance

Conference abroad every other year

Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday

Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office

Apply today and be a part of Northmill!

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Audio Software Developer  Automotive
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Audio Software Developer to join our Automotive Product Team, part of Engineering within Dirac's R&D organization. If you're an experienced embedded developer who wants to work with cutting-edge audio technology and help shape how the cars of tomorrow sound, this role is for you.
What Dirac offers you
At Dirac, you'll work in an entrepreneurial environment with people who are passionate about inventing the future of sound. You'll join a collaborative agile team that values quality, continuous improvement and having fun along the way.
Automotive is a key strategic focus for Dirac, and our ambition is to become number one in automotive audio. In this role, you'll play a central part in making that happen.
Your role
You'll develop, test and maintain our Intelligent Audio Platform (IAP), a scalable software platform that brings our audio technology to automotive DSPs and SoCs for in-car audio experiences. You'll work closely with our algorithm team and other software teams in Sweden, Denmark and India.
Your main responsibilities include:
Developing, integrating and testing new audio processing blocks in the IAP
Maintaining and improving the IAP architecture for scalability, configurability and ease of integration in customer programs
Providing 2nd-line technical support to our automotive customer programs
Driving improvements to our development processes and ways of working

Your initial focus will be to build a deep understanding of our IAP architecture and the automotive business context, so you can work independently on prioritized features and improvements. Longer term, you'll take ownership of features and epics from start to finish, with a clear path to a technical lead role.
Who you are
You're a team player who believes the best results come from "we" rather than "me". You take ownership, know how to balance risk, quality and speed, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with others.
Must have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, mathematics, or electronics
At least 5 years of professional software development experience, a significant part of it in embedded systems
Strong embedded C skills, including real-time and performance-critical code
Experience designing scalable, configurable software platforms or frameworks
Working knowledge of C++, Python and CMake
Solid engineering practices such as code reviews, test-driven development, CI and test automation
Strong communication skills in English

It is a plus if you have:
Hands-on experience with DSP (Digital Signal Processing), ideally on embedded DSP architectures and/or in the audio domain
Experience in developing cross platform libraries that target multiple different architectures
Experience with application development frameworks such as Qt
Experience from a structured, regulated development environment (e.g., Automotive SPICE or medical devices)
Experience with embedded operating systems such as an RTOS, embedded Linux, QNX or Android Automotive
A background in audio, e.g., acoustics, audio software or audio hardware

About Dirac
Dirac is one of Sweden's fastest-growing audio tech companies, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world's most reputable brands. We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, and representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States. Read more at https://www.dirac.com/.
Location, travel, and start date
This is a permanent, full-time, office-based position at our headquarters in central Uppsala, with some travel included. Start date: as soon as possible.
Questions and application
For questions about the role, contact hiring manager Allan Westphal at allan.westphal@dirac.com. 
Selection is ongoing, so apply as soon as possible. We look forward to your application!

jobs.description:
At Web Manuals, we’re redefining aviation with our state-of-the-art SaaS solutions. Our mission? To revolutionize how aviation professionals work while reaching new heights of innovation and service. As a bootstrapped company, we chart our own course, breaking barriers and setting our sights on the stars and beyond. We’re proud to offer an environment where you can soar, both professionally and personally, and explore a world of opportunities within an international team.
With offices in Malmö (HQ), San Diego, New York, Sydney, Singapore and Barcelona, we’re growing rapidly. Now, we’re on the hunt for a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Malmö!
Take the leap and join Web Manuals on our journey to revolutionize aviation - apply today!

About the role
As a Customer Success Associate, you’ll help our customers get the most out of the Web Manuals product suite, from their first day as a customer and onward. You’ll take part in onboarding projects, build your own customer relationships, and make sure our customers feel supported every step of the way. Your goal is to make sure customers not only stay with us, but grow with us. The better you know your customers, the better you’ll spot where Web Manuals can help them do even more.
You won’t be doing this alone. You’ll have a knowledgeable and experienced team by your side to support you as you learn and grow in the role. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves working with people and wants to make a real impact on both our customers and our company’s growth.

Your key responsibilities
Plan and run customer onboarding projects, making sure they’re delivered on time and leave customers happy
Take ownership of a portfolio of smaller customer accounts with lower ARR, driving their success and identifying opportunities for growth and expansion
Drive renewals and grow the value of your accounts by identifying and closing upsell opportunities
Get to know your customers’ workflows, challenges and goals so you can help them get maximum value from our platform
Build long-term relationships with customers through regular check-ins, meetings and on-site visits
Keep customers up to date on product releases, new features and upcoming events
Work with other teams to advocate for customer needs and help drive product improvements
Keep customer information accurate and up to date in our CRM and internal systems
Handle invoicing of licenses and project fees according to our processes
Escalate more complex or commercial questions to your team manager when needed

What we're looking for
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Experience in a similar role
A customer-first mindset and a genuine interest in understanding what customers need
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Fluency in English, both spoken and written
A technical aptitude and a problem-solving mindset, and comfort picking up new software and systems
A structured way of working, so you can manage your time and keep several tasks moving at once
You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and enjoy working with others to reach shared goals
A commercial drive and a natural eye for opportunities. You enjoy turning great customer conversations into growth.

Other information
Start date: ASAP
Location: Malmö
Work extent: Full time
Travel: Regular customer visits and occasional internal events

Transcom is at the forefront of innovation, including in the online shopping experience. You’ll actively listen, empathize, and engage with customers, offering tailored solutions, advice, and information. What are we looking for?
Intermediate English (B2+) – both written and spoken.
Native or fluent in Norwegian.
Previous customer service experience, especially within retail, eCommerce, or any customer-focused role, is highly valued.
Excellent communication skills with an ability to empathize and build rapport.
Positive attitude, resilience, and ability to handle challenging customer interactions gracefully.
Good problem-solving skills, with the creativity to offer quick and effective solutions.
Ability to multitask comfortably in a fast-paced environment.

What's life like at Transcom?
We have over 33,000+ customer experience specialists in 29 countries with 90 sites, delivering services in 33 languages for international brands across various industries. Thanks to our recent success, we are expanding our award-winning team and investing in our employees.
At Transcom, we are relentlessly committed. To our clients and each other. Every day, someone starts their journey with Transcom. They take the potential they have today and transform it into skills for the future. They get recognized for working hard, being a team player, and supporting others. They stand up for positive, lasting change in their teams and communities.
That's how we are at Transcom. Here, we care and cheer each other on. You're included, just as you are, from day one. And with the right attitude, there’s no limit to how far we can go together. We are committed to your growth and success.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

What you'll do:
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing. As a mechanical/electromechanical technician in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment in the design and construction of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.

Your responsibilities:
- Participate in the production, testing and installation of the Pixel Outer System services and their support structures (e.g. trolleys).
- Support the design, manufacturing and installation of temporary services and infrastructure for testing during the integration of the Pixel Detector.
- Participate hands-on in the integration of the Pixel Outer System and its insertion into ITk in the SR1 cleanroom, contributing to the development and fabrication of the corresponding tooling.
- Participate in the ITk installation in the ATLAS cavern, supporting preparation of Pixel services for installation as well as connections after insertion.
- Document manufacturing and installation procedures as well QC information of tools and production parts to ensure traceability.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in conventional precision machining of metallic and non-metallic parts, using both conventional and non-conventional methods.
- Good understanding of mechanical and electrical drawings, including geometrical tolerance specifications.
- Demonstrated experience in the assembly of complex, high precision mechanical systems with high quality standards.
- Proven experience in manufacturing and installation of cable bundles and harnesses.

jobs.occupation: Application Consultant to our Customer Success team
jobs.description:
Do you want to work closely with customers in the fitness industry and help them maximize the value of our market-leading business management platform? Do you enjoy a role where you combine project management, consulting, and customer interaction? Then you could be the person we’re looking for.
We are currently looking for several Application Consultants to join BRP Systems at one of our offices in Sweden (Linköping) or Norway (Asker).
We welcome different profiles – perhaps you have a strong technical background and enjoy system configuration and problem-solving, or maybe you’re motivated by leading customers through larger implementation projects in a project management role. Regardless of your focus, you will become part of our international Customer Success team, working alongside colleagues in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
About the Role
As an Application Consultant, you will work closely with both new and existing customers to ensure they achieve the greatest possible business value from our solutions.
Your responsibilities can include:
Project management and/or delivery of onboarding and implementation projects
System configuration, installation, and setup
Advising customers on system design and business processes
Analyzing customer requirements and translating them into effective solutions
Implementing new features and managing system upgrades
Working with integrations and third-party solutions
Delivering training sessions for customers and colleagues
Providing ongoing consulting services and handling change requests for existing customers

As an Application Consultant, you will have the opportunity to focus on shorter consulting assignments, quickly helping customers with system changes, configuration, and advisory services. You might also manage larger implementation projects, acting as project manager and serving as the customer’s primary point of contact throughout the onboarding process. Both areas require a high level of professionalism, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently.
Who We’re Looking For
We believe you’ll thrive in a growing company where the pace is high and change is a natural part of everyday work. You enjoy working closely with customers and are motivated by solving problems, working in a structured way, and building long-term relationships.
You are proactive, take ownership of your work, and are skilled at planning and balancing the needs and expectations of multiple stakeholders.
To succeed in this role, we believe you:
Have experience working in a customer-facing, consultative role
Learn and understand complex systems and business processes quickly
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Communicate clearly and build trust with both customers and colleagues
Take ownership of your assignments and drive them forward in a structured manner

We would also like you to have:
A bachelor’s degree in Economics, IT, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience
Strong IT skills
Fluency in English and in Swedish or Norwegian, both written and spoken

Experience with software implementations, project management, ERP or business management systems, SaaS solutions, or system integrations is considered an advantage. However, we place great emphasis on your personality, motivation, and willingness to learn.
Experience in the fitness industry, particularly in a role such as system administrator or similar, is highly valued.
What We Offer
At BRP Systems, you’ll work alongside engaged and knowledgeable colleagues on products that contribute to people’s health and well-being. You’ll become part of an international company with customers and colleagues across several countries, offering excellent opportunities to develop your technical expertise, consulting skills, and project management capabilities.
Join us on an exciting growth journey with the market leader in management solutions for the fitness industry!

UIG keeps growing, time to join UIG!
About us!
Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.
With a growing collection of restaurant brands, including Basta, Florentine, Trattoria Giorgio's, Lola Maria, and Villa Valentina, we're building something exciting across Europe.

What you'll be doing

Lead accurate and timely monthly, quarterly and year-end closing, including accruals, reconciliations and intercompany balances.

Prepare reliable internal and statutory reporting, providing clear financial information to colleagues across the business.

Ensure compliance with Swedish accounting standards, including K2 and K3, as well as relevant VAT, tax and reporting requirements.

Coordinate the Swedish audit process, preparing documentation and acting as the main contact for auditors and external advisers.

Strengthen internal controls and standardise accounting processes across the group, identifying risks or discrepancies early.

Improve and automate financial processes using Fortnox, digital tools and AI, while supporting the introduction of future finance systems.You'll thrive in this role if you 

You'll thrive in this role if you 
At least four years of hands-on accounting experience, ideally within a multi-entity group, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

Strong knowledge of Swedish accounting regulations, K2 and K3, monthly closing and year-end reporting.

Solid experience across the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, GL, reconciliations, accruals and statutory reporting.

Confidence using Fortnox and Excel, with an interest in new systems, automation and AI-supported ways of working.

The ability to manage several entities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Fluency in Swedish and English, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to both finance and non-finance colleagues.

A proactive and hands-on approach—you take ownership, build structure and look for solutions when processes can be improved.

Our culture and values
We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Excellence, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.
What do we offer? 
Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

Build your career across multiple brands, functions and countries.

Work alongside talented people who are passionate about hospitality and growth.

International career and development opportunities.

The chance to influence how we work as the group continues to expand.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial and international office environment.

Employee discounts across UIG restaurants.

Referral bonus scheme.

Great colleagues—and quite possibly friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place? 
If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion to UIG!
Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

Om kunden
Konfidentiellt, mer information ges vid intervjutillfälle. 
Om tjänsten
Som skribent arbetar du med att ta fram tydliga och användarvänliga manualer och instruktioner för tekniskt avancerade produkter och system. Dokumentationen ska ge användaren rätt förutsättningar att installera, använda, underhålla och reparera systemen på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.
En stor del av rollen handlar om att samla in och förstå information. Du har nära kontakt med olika tekniska kompetenser och behöver söka upp rätt personer, ställa frågor och skapa dig en förståelse för hur produkterna fungerar och hur olika delar hänger ihop. Därefter omsätter du informationen till tydlig och strukturerad dokumentation anpassad för användaren.
Du kan arbeta parallellt i flera projekt och kommer bland annat att:

samla in och bearbeta teknisk information

skapa och uppdatera manualer och instruktioner

dokumentera både mjukvara och hårdvara

samarbeta med konstruktörer, tekniker, projektledare och andra specialister

hantera uppdateringar och förbättringar av befintlig dokumentation

delta i granskning och kvalitetssäkring av material

bidra med idéer kring hur arbetssätt och processer kan utvecklas

När du börjar får du en introduktion där du arbetar nära erfarna kollegor och successivt lär känna produkterna, projekten och arbetssätten. I takt med att du kommer in i rollen får du större eget ansvar och arbetar mer självständigt. Du kommer till ett prestigelöst team om ca 10 andra skribenter i blandade åldrar och erfarenheter där det finns mycket kunskap att hämta.
Tjänsten är en tillväxtrekrytering för att utöka kapaciteten på teamet
Din kompetens
Vi söker dig som tycker om kombinationen av teknik och kommunikation. Du behöver inte kunna allt om produkterna från början, men du behöver vara nyfiken och vilja sätta dig in i hur tekniska system fungerar.
Vi ser att du har:

relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis teknikinformation, teknik/ingenjörsområde eller media och kommunikation

minst ett års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom exempelvis tekniskt skrivande, journalistik, media och kommunikation eller liknande

goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Det är meriterande men inget krav om du har erfarenhet av:

teknisk dokumentation

produktutveckling

underhålls-, reparations-, test- eller felsökningsinstruktioner

XML, CMS eller liknande verktyg för dokumentationshantering

Simplified Technical English

översättningshantering

Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop eller Excel

Du är nyfiken och tycker om att ta reda på hur saker fungerar. Eftersom all information inte alltid finns samlad framför dig behöver du vara bekväm med att själv söka information, ställa frågor och ta kontakt med personer med olika tekniska kompetenser. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har ett öga för detaljer. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och trivs med att samarbeta med andra. Du tar initiativ när det behövs och har ett intresse för teknik och för att förstå hur produkter är uppbyggda och används.
Övrigt
Lön: Fast månadslön
Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidare
Start: Omgående med hänsyn tagen till din eventuella uppsägningstid
Placeringsort: Jönköping
Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut, skicka din ansökan redan idag!
Om oss
Procruitment är Sveriges enda karriärbyrå inom IT, tech och engineering som genom proaktiv rekrytering förenar attraktiva arbetsgivare med människor som delar samma mål och ambitioner. Oavsett om du är en erfaren ledare eller om du ska ta ditt första steg ut i karriären hjälper vi dig att nå dina karriärmål - samtidigt som vi bryr oss om dig, din resa och att du mår bra längs vägen.
Procruitment är stolta vinnare av Recruitment Awards och är utsedda till Årets Rekryteringsföretag och Årets Raket samt Gasellföretag 2024 av Dagens Industri.

The Verification & Quality Lead is responsible for coordinating verification activities and quality follow-up across the Platform. The role establishes and maintains verification plans and strategies, monitors execution and quality status, coordinates defect management, and provides clear reporting on verification progress and release readiness. The role works closely with technical leadership, development, integration, test, and other engineering stakeholders to ensure that verification evidence and quality information support informed delivery decisions.
Requirements:
Significant experience as a Verification Lead, Quality Lead, Test Manager, Verification Manager, or in a comparable senior engineering role.
Strong experience in automotive software verification and validation, preferably involving embedded software and complex electronic control units or comparable platforms.
Experience defining verification strategies, planning test activities, managing execution, assessing coverage, and reporting results against requirements and milestones.
Practical experience in defect management, triage, root-cause follow-up, regression testing, and quality improvement.
Good understanding of software development lifecycles, integration processes, release-readiness assessment, and evidence-based quality decisions.
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) verification, automated testing, and integration test workflows.
Ability to define and interpret verification and quality KPIs, identify trends, and communicate quality status and risks clearly.
Experience coordinating cross-functional engineering teams and managing dependencies across development, integration, and testing.
Familiarity with automotive engineering processes, quality practices, requirements traceability, and applicable organizational standards.
Working knowledge of test automation or scripting, such as Python, Pytest, YAML, or Bash, is beneficial.
Experience with test tools such as CANoe and with CI, issue tracking, reporting, and documentation tools is beneficial.
Strong analytical, organizational, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Relevant Tools and Technologies:
Test and verification: CANoe, Pytest, and other applicable verification tools.
CI/CD and automation: Jenkins, GitLab CI, Zuul, Cynosure, Ansible.
Programming and scripting: Python, Bash, YAML; C/C++ familiarity is beneficial.
Version control and review: Git, Gerrit.
Test execution environments and packaging: Docker, Artifactory.
Monitoring and reporting: Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, and relevant engineering dashboards.
Planning, defect tracking, and documentation: Jira, Confluence, and applicable engineering lifecycle tools.
Processes and standards: applicable engineering frameworks, verification processes, and organizational software quality standards

Job Responsibilities:
Define, maintain, and coordinate the platform verification strategy, verification plans, scope, priorities, and execution approach in line with agreed requirements and milestones.
Coordinate verification activities across relevant engineering workstreams, ensuring suitable coverage of requirements, software changes, interfaces, integration scenarios, and identified risks.
Track verification execution, results, test coverage, outstanding activities, and deviations against the agreed plan.
Establish and maintain clear quality reporting, verification status, metrics, dashboards, and progress summaries for engineering and program stakeholders.
Coordinate defect management, including defect triage, severity and priority discussions, ownership, follow-up, retesting, and closure tracking.
Work with development and integration teams to ensure defects are analyzed, corrective actions are tracked, and regression risks are addressed.
Monitor quality trends and verification KPIs; identify recurring issues, gaps, and risks, and recommend corrective or preventive actions.
Coordinate test readiness and release-readiness assessments, consolidating verification evidence, open defects, residual risks, and unresolved quality concerns.
